shots.title: IT BENDS ON PURPOSE
shots.caption: A flexible barrier
shots.narration: This steel rail bends to soften a car crash.

shots.title: ONE CONNECTED BEAM
shots.caption: Beam + posts + soil
shots.narration: The steel beam joins posts, spreading the crash force along connected sections.

shots.title: THE BEAM BENDS
shots.caption: The beam absorbs energy
shots.narration: The beam bends under the car, absorbing energy as the impact spreads along the whole barrier.

shots.title: POSTS SHARE THE LOAD
shots.caption: Connections transfer forces
shots.narration: The posts rotate in the soil, and their connections help share the crash load between them.

shots.title: REDIRECTING THE CAR
shots.caption: Along the road
shots.narration: Together, they redirect the car along the road, away from the hazards beyond.

shots.title: IT HAS LIMITS
shots.caption: Vehicle + speed + impact angle
shots.narration: Protection has limits. Vehicle size, speed, and impact angle all change the outcome.
